name: D4T Seed Custody Exact Windows Self-Test
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - d4t-seed-custody-ci-20261110
jobs:
  exact:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Reconstruct exact frozen PS file
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $b64=''+''
          $gz=[Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)
          $mi=[IO.MemoryStream]::new($gz)
          $zs=[IO.Compression.GZipStream]::new($mi,[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
          $mo=[IO.MemoryStream]::new()
          try {
            $zs.CopyTo($mo)
            $bytes=$mo.ToArray()
            $downloads=Join-Path $HOME 'Downloads'
            [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($downloads)|Out-Null
            $path=Join-Path $downloads 'D4T_SEED_CUSTODY.ps1'
            [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($path,$bytes)
            $actual=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $path).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            if($actual -ne '00c1c8951767c5a7bc3f5d0899d3b113bbb5b3f7b9c155cc27229300e9638018'){throw "HASH_MISMATCH::$actual"}
            "EXACT_SCRIPT_SHA256=$actual"
          } finally {
            if($bytes){[Array]::Clear($bytes,0,$bytes.Length)}
            $mo.Dispose();$zs.Dispose();$mi.Dispose();[Array]::Clear($gz,0,$gz.Length)
          }
      - name: Execute exact script self-test
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $path=Join-Path (Join-Path $HOME 'Downloads') 'D4T_SEED_CUSTODY.ps1'
          $out=& pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $path -SelfTest 2>&1
          $code=$LASTEXITCODE
          $out|ForEach-Object{Write-Output $_}
          if($code -ne 0){throw "SELFTEST_EXIT::$code"}
          $text=$out -join "`n"
          foreach($required in @('D4T_SEED_CUSTODY_STATUS=PASS','D4T_PRIMARY_CUSTODY_REPLAY=PASS','D4T_BACKUP_CUSTODY_REPLAY=PASS','D4T_CUSTODY_COMMITMENT_EQUALITY=PASS','D4T_SEED_CUSTODY_WINDOWS_SELFTEST=PASS')){
            if(-not $text.Contains($required)){throw "MISSING_SELFTEST_MARKER::$required"}
          }
      - name: Execute exact final launcher
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          D4T_SEED_CUSTODY_SELFTEST: '1'
        run: |
          $out = & { $h='00c1c8951767c5a7bc3f5d0899d3b113bbb5b3f7b9c155cc27229300e9638018'; $f=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "$HOME\Downloads" -Filter 'D4T_SEED_CUSTODY*.ps1' -File | Where-Object { (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -eq $h } | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $f){throw 'D4T_SEED_CUSTODY_FILE_NOT_FOUND_OR_HASH_MISMATCH'}; & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $f.FullName } 2>&1
          $code=$LASTEXITCODE
          $out|ForEach-Object{Write-Output $_}
          if($code -ne 0){throw "LAUNCHER_EXIT::$code"}
          $text=$out -join "`n"
          if(-not $text.Contains('D4T_SEED_CUSTODY_WINDOWS_SELFTEST=PASS')){throw 'FINAL_LAUNCHER_SELFTEST_MARKER_MISSING'}
